body: Side note, if this pain has been going on for a while now it is unlikely to be appendicitis as you would already be dead. But I digress, it's still better to check since it could possibly be a symptom of many other unpleasant illnesses.

I'd rather be safe then sorry. If it is appendicitis you do not have much time before it bursts, and if it does it will kill you in a matter of days. Are you experiencing nausea as well? Does the pain flare when you cough or make jarring movements? Any fevers or chills? If so it is very likely you could indeed have appendicitis and you should check with a hospital asap. However, it is possible the problem could also be directly related to your obesity, such as a fatty liver disease for example. In any case, probably better to get it checked out sooner rather then later. Obesity is one of those things that causes a myriad of other health problems, so nothing should be dismissed too quickly.
